## Analysis

```{r}
#| label: first overview

# import data from data folder
data_aug <- read.table("../data/data_aug")

  
# absolute of expression of all the genes over time VIOLIN
data_aug |> 
  mutate(timepoint = as.factor(timepoint)) |> 
  ggplot(mapping = aes(x = timepoint,
                      y = expression)) +
  geom_violin(
    colour = "orange2") +
  #coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-2, 2)) +
  theme_minimal()


# overview of mu
data_aug |> 
  group_by(timepoint) |>
  mutate(expression_abs = abs(expression)) |> 
  summarise(expression_abs_mu = mean(expression_abs))

# how many genes were expressed differently with significance
dat_aug |> 
  mutate()
  group_by(gene) |> 
  mutate(
    model_object = map(.x = data, 
                       #to what existing (nested) variable are we mapping?
                       .f = ~lm(
                         formula = log_2_expr_level ~ early_metastasis,
                         data = .x))) |>  
                       #which function do we want to map to each element 
                       # in the existing (nested) variable? For each data 
                       # frame, it fits the linear model)
  mutate(
    model_object_tidy = map(.x = model_object,
                            .f = ~tidy(.x,
                                       conf.int = TRUE,
                                       conf.level = 0.95)))

```

```{r}
#| label: unused plots

# absolute of expression of all the genes over time BOXPLOT
data_aug |> 
  mutate(timepoint = as.factor(timepoint),
         expression_abs = abs(expression)) |> 
  ggplot(mapping = aes(x = timepoint,
                      y = expression_abs)) +
  geom_boxplot(
    colour = "black",
    fill = "orchid3") +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-2, 2)) +
  theme_minimal()


# absolute of expression of all the genes over time JITTER
data_aug |> 
  mutate(expression_abs = abs(expression)) |> 
  ggplot(mapping = aes(x = timepoint,
                       y = expression_abs)) +
  geom_jitter(colour = "lightblue3") +
  stat_summary(
    fun = mean) +
  #geom_line() +
  theme_minimal()
```
